definition: Cumulative systematic source/candidate and rendered-base review, clipped to the reviewed facility and excluding six protected evaluation windows. Ambiguous cells were inspected but did not pass. Woodland interiors remain density-based, not a stem census.
limitations: Older sample-window coverage is a different measure and is not added to inspected area. Per-hole 90 m line buffers overlap and must not be summed. No independent new accuracy or boundary measurement.
